newsitem.title: GREECE: ATHLETICS-PROFILE OF WORLD MEN'S TRIPLE JUMP CHAMPION QUESADA.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-PROFILE OF WORLD MEN'S TRIPLE JUMP CHAMPION QUESADA.

text.p: Profile of Yoelvis Quesada, who won the world men's triple jump title on Friday.
Pan-American champion in 1991, won the 1992 world junior title and was a bronze medallist at the Atlanta Olympics last year.
Has been a world class competitor since setting a world age-16 best in 1990 but until winning the 1997 world championship had never won a senior global title.
Holds the world age best performances for ages 15-19.
